en: A black and white vintage postcard depicting a large outdoor procession with people in historical or biblical costumes, some holding palm branches. The background shows European-style buildings and a pointed tower, suggesting an old European city. The caption at the bottom references 'BRUGES' and 'Procession du Saint Sang' (Procession of the Holy Blood), indicating a religious event.
